## Findings

1. **Measured spindle speeds fall in two classes**, ~1031 rpm and ~1461 rpm (nominal 1000 / 1400 rpm; the machine runs ~3-4 % fast). The provisional manifest speed disagrees with the measurement for **3 trials** (trial_06, trial_11, trial_16).
2. **Speed blocks.** Consecutive trials with the same measured speed form blocks: 04,06 at 1031 rpm; 07,08,09,10,11 at 1461 rpm; 12,13,14,15,16 at 1031 rpm; 17,18,19,20 at 1461 rpm.
3. **Force rises with trial order inside every block of >= 3 trials** (Spearman rho: block 07,08,09,10,11: 1.00, block 12,13,14,15,16: 1.00, block 17,18,19,20: 1.00), as expected if each block runs the planned depths 0.50 -> 1.50 mm in increasing order.
4. **Recording gaps.** Largest gaps between consecutive recordings on 2025-03-25: before trial_12: 646 s; before trial_05: 302 s; before trial_16: 191 s. The force files also change folder at trial_12.
5. **Interpretation (provisional).** Trials 12-16 (1031 rpm) and 17-20 (1461 rpm; trial_21, recorded 92 s after trial_20, has no force file) form one complete 10-cut plan on one specimen (block B); trials up to 11 belong to another specimen (block A: 1031 rpm up to trial 06, 1461 rpm for 07-11). The original manifest assumed the boundary between trials 10 and 11 and is shifted by one trial.
6. **Material.** The only file-level material evidence concerns trials 01 and 03 (byte-identical copies in the `AM ER5356` folder). Both were recorded on 2025-03-14, a different session from all force records (2025-03-25), at a different accelerometer rate, so they do not identify the material of block A or B. **No trial with a force record has a confirmed material (0 WAAM, 0 wrought).**

## Consequence for the paper

* Main results do not use material identity, depth of cut or the manifest speed; the measured spindle speed is used instead.
* The material-specific supplementary analysis requires >= 4 confirmed trials per material; with 0 confirmed it is **omitted**.
* The specimen-block grouping (A/B) rests on timing, speed and file provenance only and is reported as provisional. The lab log is needed to name the material of each block (TODO_AUTHOR.md).
